signInIntro: Sign in to find a room and manage your meetings.
accountHelp: Use your staff account. For account access or password recovery, contact your administrator.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
offline: Cannot connect. Check your connection and try again.
timeout: The server took too long to respond. Check the result before submitting again.
invalidResponse: The server returned an unexpected response.
forbidden: You do not have permission to access this information.
notFound: This record is no longer available.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
homeIntro: Find your next meeting space and keep your bookings on track.
noMeetings: No confirmed meetings in this period.
scheduleIntro: Confirmed room meetings, organized by date and department.
roomsIntro: Choose when you need a room. We’ll help you find a suitable space.
validCount: Enter a whole number greater than zero.
validInterval: Choose a future start and an end after the start.
availabilityHint: Availability is checked again by the server. A pending request does not reserve a room.
searchRoomsHint: Choose a time and search for available rooms.
noRooms: No rooms match. Try another time or fewer filters.
attachmentRules: Up to 5 files, 10 MB each. PDF, Office documents, PNG or JPEG.
bookingIntro: Provide the information the approver needs to review your request.
attendeeHint: Include yourself and any guests in the total.
capacityError: Enter a total within room capacity, including you and selected staff.
pendingHint: This request reserves the room only after approval.
attendeesOnly: Attendees are recorded for this booking. No calendar invitations or attendance responses are created.
approvalsIntro: Review pending requests. Open a booking to make a decision.
myBookingsIntro: Track requests and manage your room bookings.
approvalHint: Approval performs a final conflict check. If another meeting reserves the room, approval will be blocked.
checkOutHint: Complete this meeting and release the room?
laterEnd: Choose a time later than the current end time.
signOutHint: Sign out of MeetSpace on this device?
passwordHint: Changing your password ends your sessions. Sign in again afterwards.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
noFileViewer: Install an app that can open this file type.
nativeAttachments: Open attachments in the Android or iOS app.
